title: The gérondif and adverbs in -ment
summary: Say how and while with en + -ant (en mangeant, en faisant), and how something is done with adverbs in -ment (lentement, évidemment).
focus: The gérondif and forming and placing adverbs in -ment
content:
## The gérondif: en + -ant

Take the **nous** form of the present, drop **-ons**, add **-ant**, and put **en** in front:

| nous form | gérondif |
|---|---|
| nous mangeons | **en mangeant** |
| nous faisons | **en faisant** |
| nous finissons | **en finissant** |
| nous courons | **en courant** |

Three verbs are irregular: **être → en étant**, **avoir → en ayant**, **savoir → en sachant**.

The gérondif never changes its ending, and it always refers to the **subject** of the main verb: **J'ai vu Paul en sortant** = I saw Paul as *I* was leaving.

## When, how, while: using it

- **Two actions at the same time**: **Il chante en se douchant.** (He sings in the shower.)
- **The means, how**: **Elle a appris le français en regardant des séries.** (She learnt French by watching series.)
- **A condition**: **En partant maintenant, tu arriveras à l'heure.** (If you leave now, you'll be on time.)
- **Tout en** stresses that two things go together, often in contrast: **Tout en étant fatiguée, elle a fini son travail.** (Even though she was tired, she finished her work.)

## Adverbs in -ment

- Feminine adjective + **-ment**: lente → **lentement**, heureuse → **heureusement**, douce → **doucement**.
- Adjective ending in a vowel: masculine + **-ment**: vrai → **vraiment**, poli → **poliment**.
- **-ent → -emment**, **-ant → -amment**, both said *-amment*: évident → **évidemment**, courant → **couramment**.
- Irregular: gentil → **gentiment**, bon → **bien**.

**Placement**: after the conjugated verb (**Il parle lentement**). In the passé composé, short adverbs go between the auxiliary and the participle (**J'ai bien dormi**, **Il a vite compris**); long -ment adverbs usually go after the participle (**Il a répondu poliment**).

vocabulary.example: Je cours tous les matins dans le parc.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I run every morning in the park.

vocabulary.example: J'ai rencontré Lucie en faisant les courses.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I met Lucie while doing the shopping.

vocabulary.example: En étant patient, on obtient beaucoup.
vocabulary.example_meaning: By being patient, you get a lot.

vocabulary.example: Il est parti en sachant qu'il allait pleuvoir.
vocabulary.example_meaning: He left knowing it was going to rain.

vocabulary.example: Tout en étant fatiguée, elle a fini son travail.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Even though she was tired, she finished her work.

vocabulary.example: Parlez lentement, s'il vous plaît.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Speak slowly, please.

vocabulary.example: Heureusement, le train était à l'heure.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Luckily, the train was on time.

vocabulary.example: Malheureusement, le magasin est fermé.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Unfortunately, the shop is closed.

vocabulary.example: Évidemment, il a oublié son parapluie.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Of course, he forgot his umbrella.

vocabulary.example: Elle parle couramment trois langues.
vocabulary.example_meaning: She speaks three languages fluently.

vocabulary.example: J'ai vraiment aimé ce film.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I really liked this film.

vocabulary.example: Le voisin m'a gentiment aidé.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The neighbour kindly helped me.

vocabulary.example: Il a répondu rapidement à mon message.
vocabulary.example_meaning: He answered my message quickly.

vocabulary.example: Parle doucement, le bébé dort.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Speak softly, the baby is asleep.

quiz.explanation: The means (how I learnt) is a gérondif: en + nous stem + -ant, 'en regardant'.
hints: Start from nous regardons: the stem is regard-.

quiz.explanation: Nous faisons gives the stem fais-, plus -ant: 'en faisant'.

quiz.prompt: Which is the gérondif of avoir?
quiz.explanation: Avoir is one of the three irregulars: en ayant (with être → en étant, savoir → en sachant).
hints: It is irregular, with a y.

quiz.prompt: Le dimanche, nous ___ (courir) lentement au bord du lac.
quiz.explanation: Courir in the present: je cours, tu cours, il court, nous courons, vous courez, ils courent. One r in the present.
hints: Only one r in the present.

quiz.explanation: An adverb is needed to say how she speaks: courant gives couramment (-ant becomes -amment).
Évident ends in -ent, so the adverb is évidemment (-ent becomes -emment).

quiz.prompt: In 'J'ai bien dormi', the adverb bien goes between the auxiliary and the participle.
quiz.explanation: Yes: short adverbs like bien, mal, vite, déjà sit between avoir/être and the participle.
hints: Where is bien in the sentence?

quiz.prompt: Tout ___ fatigué, il a continué à travailler.
quiz.explanation: Tout en + gérondif of être (en étant): even though he was tired.
hints: The gérondif of être is irregular.

quiz.prompt: In 'J'ai vu Paul en sortant', it is Paul who is leaving.
quiz.explanation: The gérondif refers to the subject of the main verb: I saw Paul as I was leaving.
hints: Who is the subject of ai vu?

conversations.title: Running partners
conversations.scenario: Julie and Karim, two colleagues, meet at the coffee machine and talk about running.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Salut Julie ! Tu cours toujours le matin ?
lines.meaning: Hi Julie! Do you still run in the mornings?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Oui, je cours trois fois par semaine, en écoutant des podcasts.
lines.meaning: Yes, I run three times a week, listening to podcasts.
lines.note: en écoutant: at the same time

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Moi, je cours plutôt le soir, en rentrant du travail.
lines.meaning: I tend to run in the evening, on my way home from work.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Pas vraiment. Je cours lentement, mais longtemps.
lines.meaning: Not really. I run slowly, but for a long time.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: C'est en courant régulièrement qu'on progresse.
lines.meaning: It's by running regularly that you improve.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Évidemment ! Et tu prépares le semi-marathon ?
lines.meaning: Of course! And are you training for the half marathon?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Oui. Heureusement, mon genou va mieux.
lines.meaning: Yes. Luckily, my knee is better.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Tu veux courir avec moi dimanche ?
lines.meaning: Do you want to run with me on Sunday?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Avec plaisir ! On pourra discuter tout en courant.
lines.meaning: With pleasure! We'll be able to chat while we run.

listening.text: Elle chante en cuisinant.
listening.meaning: She sings while cooking.

listening.text: Nous courons lentement le dimanche.
listening.meaning: We run slowly on Sundays.

listening.text: Heureusement, le bus est arrivé rapidement.
listening.meaning: Luckily, the bus came quickly.

listening.text: Il a appris l'italien en écoutant la radio.
listening.meaning: He learnt Italian by listening to the radio.

listening.text: Malheureusement, mon frère ne parle pas couramment l'anglais.
listening.meaning: Unfortunately, my brother doesn't speak English fluently.

listening.text: En partant maintenant, vous arriverez à l'heure à la gare.
listening.meaning: If you leave now, you'll get to the station on time.
listening.note: New word: à l'heure = on time.

listening.text: Mon grand-père s'est cassé la jambe en tombant dans l'escalier.
listening.meaning: My grandfather broke his leg falling down the stairs.

listening.text: Tout en étant très occupée, elle répond gentiment à tout le monde.
listening.meaning: Even though she's very busy, she answers everyone kindly.

guide.tip: To build the gérondif, say the nous form out loud and swap -ons for -ant, so nous prenons becomes en prenant.

concept.title: The -ant form without en
concept.markdown: In written French the -ant form also appears without **en**, as the participe présent: **Ayant fini, il est parti.** (Having finished, he left.) **Une femme parlant trois langues.** (A woman speaking three languages.) You will read it more than you say it.

bites.title: en + -ant
bites.rule: Take the nous form, drop -ons, add -ant, put en in front, so nous faisons gives en faisant. Irregular: en étant, en ayant, en sachant.
bites.example: Il travaille en écoutant de la musique.
bites.example_meaning: He works while listening to music.

bites.title: While, by, if
bites.rule: The gérondif says two things happen together, how something is done, or on what condition. Tout en stresses the contrast.
bites.example: C'est en forgeant qu'on devient forgeron.
bites.example_meaning: Practice makes perfect. (Literally: it's by forging that you become a blacksmith.)

bites.title: Adjective plus -ment
bites.rule: Feminine adjective + -ment (lente gives lentement); vowel ending + -ment (vrai gives vraiment); -ent becomes -emment, -ant becomes -amment.

bites.title: Where it goes
bites.rule: After the conjugated verb. In the passé composé, short adverbs go before the participle: j'ai bien dormi, il a vite compris.

sorts.title: -emment or -amment?
sorts.why: Adjectives in -ent give -emment (évidemment), adjectives in -ant give -amment (couramment). Both sound the same.

sorts.title: What does the gérondif express?

items.text: Elle a maigri en faisant du sport.
Il a réussi en travaillant dur.
On s'est rencontrés en attendant le bus.

sorts.why: If the -ant action happens alongside the other, it's simultaneity; if it explains how the result came about, it's the means.

spots.sentence: Il travaille en écoutent de la musique.
spots.why: The gérondif ends in -ant: en écoutant.
Build it on the feminine adjective: lente + -ment.

spots.sentence: Évidament, il a raté le bus.
Nous courrons tous les matins dans le parc.
spots.why: Present tense: nous courons, one r. Courrons with two r's is the futur.

builds.text: Elle chante en faisant la cuisine.
Heureusement, nous sommes arrivés à l'heure.

realm.content:
## Le gérondif à Eldmark

The huntress tracks the wolf **en marchant lentement**; the mage casts **en chantant doucement**; Borin learnt to fight **en regardant** his father. **En + -ant** = while or by doing. **-ment** adverbs say how: **prudemment**, **silencieusement**, **courageusement**.

vocabulary.example: Les loups courent vite dans la Forêt Ombreuse.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The wolves run fast in the Shadowed Forest.

vocabulary.example: Nym a trouvé un parchemin en faisant le tour du donjon.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Nym found a scroll while going round the dungeon.

vocabulary.example: Le minotaure marche lentement.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The minotaur walks slowly.

vocabulary.example: Heureusement, le paladin avait une potion.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Luckily, the paladin had a potion.

vocabulary.example: Parle doucement, le dragon dort.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Speak softly, the dragon is asleep.

vocabulary.example: Évidemment, l'orc veut tout le butin.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Of course, the orc wants all the loot.

vocabulary.example: Tout en étant petit, Borin est très courageux.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Even though he is small, Borin is very brave.

vocabulary.example: Le loup hurle en regardant la lune.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The wolf howls while looking at the moon.

vocabulary.example: La chasseuse avance en écoutant la forêt.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The huntress moves forward listening to the forest.

vocabulary.example: Les elfes marchent silencieusement dans la forêt.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The elves walk silently through the forest.

bites.title: La chasse dans la forêt
bites.rule: En + -ant: two actions at once, or how it is done. A -ment adverb says how.
bites.example: La chasseuse avance lentement en écoutant la forêt.
bites.example_meaning: The huntress moves forward slowly, listening to the forest.

listening.text: Les loups courent dans la forêt.
listening.meaning: The wolves run in the forest.
listening.note: New word: le loup = the wolf.

listening.text: Marchez doucement, les loups dorment.
listening.meaning: Walk softly, the wolves are sleeping.

listening.text: Nym chante en marchant.
listening.meaning: Nym sings as she walks.

listening.text: Heureusement, la mage connaissait le sort.
listening.meaning: Luckily, the mage knew the spell.

listening.text: La chasseuse avance silencieusement en suivant le loup.
listening.meaning: The huntress moves silently, following the wolf.

builds.meaning: Of course, the orc wants the loot.

spots.why: The gérondif ends in -ant: en marchant.
Build it on the feminine adjective: silencieuse + -ment.

sorts.title: How is the adverb built?
sorts.why: Most adverbs add -ment to the feminine adjective; adjectives in -ent and -ant give -emment and -amment.

quiz.explanation: To say how she follows the wolf you need an adverb: silencieuse + -ment.

quiz.prompt: Borin a appris à se battre en ___ (regarder) son père.
quiz.explanation: The means: nous regardons gives en regardant.

meadowbrook.content:
## Le gérondif à Meadowbrook

Léo fishes **en chantant**, Nora waters the strawberries **en écoutant** the river, and you earn your coins **en vendant** your corn at the market. Say how with **-ment**: on arrose **doucement**, on récolte **rapidement** avant la pluie.

vocabulary.example: J'ai trouvé un champignon en faisant une promenade dans la forêt.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I found a mushroom while going for a walk in the forest.

vocabulary.example: On récolte le maïs rapidement avant la pluie.
vocabulary.example_meaning: We harvest the corn quickly before the rain.

vocabulary.example: Arrose doucement les jeunes plantes.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Water the young plants gently.

vocabulary.example: Heureusement, il a plu cette nuit.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Luckily, it rained last night.

vocabulary.example: Le maire m'a gentiment prêté sa charrette.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The mayor kindly lent me his cart.

vocabulary.example: Tes fraises sont vraiment délicieuses.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Your strawberries are really delicious.

vocabulary.example: Les cochons courent dans le pré.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The pigs run in the meadow.

vocabulary.example: Léo pêche en sifflant.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Léo fishes while whistling.

vocabulary.example: Je me repose en regardant la rivière.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I rest while watching the river.

vocabulary.example: Nora arrose les fraises en écoutant la radio.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Nora waters the strawberries while listening to the radio.

bites.title: Au bord de la rivière
bites.rule: En + -ant joins two actions by the same person; a -ment adverb says how.

listening.text: Léo pêche en chantant.
listening.meaning: Léo fishes while singing.

listening.text: Le mouton court lentement dans le pré.
listening.meaning: The sheep runs slowly in the meadow.
listening.note: New word: le pré = the meadow.

listening.text: Arrose doucement les fraises.
listening.meaning: Water the strawberries gently.

listening.text: Heureusement, Léo a trouvé la vache.
listening.meaning: Luckily, Léo found the cow.

listening.text: Nora gagne de l'argent en vendant son maïs.
listening.meaning: Nora earns money by selling her corn.

builds.text: Léo pêche en écoutant la rivière.
builds.meaning: Léo fishes while listening to the river.

spots.why: The gérondif ends in -ant: en chantant.

sorts.title: At the same time or how?

items.text: Nora gagne de l'argent en vendant ses œufs.
Rosa sourit en servant les clients.
On devient fermier en travaillant dur.
Je rêve en regardant la rivière.
Tu sauves ta récolte en arrosant chaque jour.

sorts.why: Singing, smiling and dreaming happen alongside the other action; selling, working and watering explain how the result comes about.

quiz.prompt: Nora gagne de l'argent en ___ (vendre) ses fraises au marché.
quiz.explanation: Nous vendons gives the stem vend-, plus -ant: 'en vendant', the means.

quiz.prompt: 'Le maire m'a gentilment aidé' is correct French.
quiz.explanation: Gentil gives the irregular adverb gentiment: 'Le maire m'a gentiment aidé'.

rustwake.content:
## Le gérondif à Rustwake

In the rust desert you survive **en réparant**, **en échangeant** and **en marchant prudemment**. Ruiz fixes the antenna **en écoutant** la radio; the giant beetle runs **rapidement** but turns **lentement**. **Tout en étant** dangereux, le désert est beau.

vocabulary.example: Le scarabée géant court très vite.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The giant beetle runs very fast.

vocabulary.example: Tout en étant vieux, ce robot marche encore.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Even though it's old, this robot still works.

vocabulary.example: Le robot jardinier avance lentement.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The gardener robot moves slowly.

vocabulary.example: Rentre rapidement au Dôme, la tempête arrive !
vocabulary.example_meaning: Get back to the Dome quickly, the storm is coming!

vocabulary.example: Malheureusement, ma radio-montre ne marche plus.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Unfortunately, my wrist radio doesn't work any more.

vocabulary.example: Évidemment, Marta veut des écrous.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Of course, Marta wants nuts.

vocabulary.example: Je suis sorti du Dôme en sachant que c'était dangereux.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I left the Dome knowing it was dangerous.

vocabulary.example: Ruiz répare l'antenne en écoutant la radio.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Ruiz repairs the antenna while listening to the radio.

vocabulary.example: Marche prudemment, il y a des scarabées.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Walk carefully, there are beetles.

vocabulary.example: Il est rentré en courant à cause de la tempête de cendres.
vocabulary.example_meaning: He ran home because of the ash storm.

bites.title: Survivre dans le désert
bites.rule: En + -ant: how you survive, or what you do at the same time. A -ment adverb says how.

listening.text: Le scarabée court rapidement.
listening.meaning: The beetle runs quickly.

listening.text: Ruiz répare la radio en sifflant.
listening.meaning: Ruiz repairs the radio while whistling.

listening.text: Marche prudemment dans le désert.
listening.meaning: Walk carefully in the desert.

listening.text: Malheureusement, la radio-montre ne marche plus.
listening.meaning: Unfortunately, the wrist radio doesn't work any more.

listening.text: Tout en marchant, Léo écoute la radio.
listening.meaning: While walking, Léo listens to the radio.

builds.meaning: Ruiz repairs the antenna while listening to the radio.

spots.sentence: Ruiz répare la radio en écoutent la musique.
spots.why: The gérondif ends in -ant: en écoutant.

spots.sentence: Marche prudament, il y a des scarabées.

sorts.title: -emment or -amment?
sorts.why: Adjectives in -ent give -emment, adjectives in -ant give -amment: prudemment, bruyamment.

quiz.prompt: On survit dans le désert ___ tout.
quiz.explanation: The means: en + nous stem + -ant, 'en réparant'.

quiz.prompt: Rentre ___ (rapide) au Dôme, la tempête arrive !
quiz.explanation: Rapide ends in a vowel: rapide + -ment = rapidement.
